scope: Offline interpretation of one frozen release relay burst run; no new acceptance threshold or causal performance attribution.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control, not a production code change; proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup, and native GPU arguments are unchanged.

interpretation: Response formal cohort uses each page performance clock, offsetting responsiveness.startedAt against measure.started. Metrics condition on non-null observations and changed masks; all missing/status counts remain visible.
firstWire is the JavaScript send observer after native capture/serialization, before transport send. It establishes neither remote ACK nor remote capture.
Presentation is a newer simulation frontier with increased renderer submissions, observed after play.frame. It establishes neither pixel movement nor physical scanout.
A superseded uncaptured intent is a missed synthetic edge. pendingAgeAtEnd is its historical age, not a continuously held input or a freeze.
Relay burst selects kind-1 packets in both directions at scheduling. sendApi is the relay WebSocket API boundary, not peer delivery or native acceptance.
Burst frame windows compare sender frame numbers to game frame bands, not exact cross-process wall-clock synchronization. Browser network packet tracing was disabled.
New-state intervals use the frozen harness rAF timestamp convention; observation gaps and C++ work are separately retained. No physical-presentation or CPU-time claim follows.

injection.packetScope: E9NP version 4 kind 1; ACK-only and redundant input included; non-input control/hash/signaling untouched; relay has no separate RTC repair lane.
injection.jitterAlgorithm: Per-sender LCG 1664525*x+1013904223, seed 0x915ab+sender; same formula as legacy client impairment. Relay forwarding order can differ.
injection.burstClock: First non-empty E9NP input receive in this relay process; distinct from browser active time.
